leaders.notes: Credited with transforming what was then Marion College into Indiana Wesleyan University and growing it into one of the largest evangelical Christian universities; became IWU's first Chancellor from 2006-2010 after stepping down as president.

IWU's ninth president; announced his retirement in 2021, effective at the end of the 2021-2022 academic year, after more than 25 years at the institution.
